response.sql: WITH driver_qualifying_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as qualifying_count FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), average_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_count) as avg_qualifying_count FROM driver_qualifying_counts) SELECT dwc.driverId, dwc.qualifying_count, CAST(dwc.qualifying_count AS REAL) / aq.avg_qualifying_count as ratio FROM driver_qualifying_counts dwc CROSS JOIN average_qualifying aq ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
